scope: Seven configurable vocational domain families and 28 scenarios; real DOM interactions, 320px content states, explicit acknowledgement and privacy boundaries. No real backend or full browser certification.

checks.name: All seven empty families and 28 configurations mount without changing caller data
All 28 scenarios and seven content states fit 320px containers
Roster transfer needs a destination and reason and commits only after acknowledgement
Roster rejected edit retains modal fields and retry does not create duplicate people
Roster number uniqueness, locked people and search filtering are actual constraints
Directory refresh preserves roster history and flags missing associations
Assignments edit multiple class IDs without embedding terms inside course objects
Primary teacher conflicts and stale directory references block activation
Assignment activation and ending require acknowledgement and an end reason
Practice prerequisites and mandatory safety acceptance block later steps
Practice material checks, required checklist and actual files gate submission
Practice rejects file type and size and keeps the existing draft
Teacher practice return requires a reason and never overwrites submission snapshots
Teacher acceptance and returned learner continuation are distinct transitions
Practice author can add real check steps using a normal form
Learning resume emits a locator without fabricating a visit or completion
Recorded progress needs acknowledgement and completion is an explicit second action
Learning prerequisite, threshold, numeric bounds and teacher permissions apply
Manual completion and reset preserve a history and require separate confirmation
Resource versions compare actual text and citations preserve the original snapshot
Unavailable resources block new references while existing snapshots stay readable
Teacher creates and publishes a new immutable resource version from actual input
Student DOM does not contain resource drafts, expired text or unsafe links
Survey false values, maximum choices, required questions and anonymous payload are real
Survey draft failure keeps answers and revision requires explicit business acknowledgement
Survey time window locks expired answers and never auto-submits
Survey author edits types, options and ordering with ordinary form controls
Survey results calculate real aggregates and remove raw responses from student DOM
Grades preserve zero and ungraded values and recompute the current edited result
Grade drafts retain edits on failure and publishing rejects incomplete selected rows
Grade bulk publication uses actual computed values and withdrawal needs a reason
Grade absence is not automatically zero and exemptions renormalize only when allowed
Student grade pages expose only own published values, never hidden drafts or other students
Grade rule author adds real columns and blocks restructuring existing scores
All seven readonly and disabled components preserve business values under attempted operations
Event-mode requests reject stale IDs, cancellation preserves drafts and duplicate submit is blocked
Promise handlers receive abort signals and rejected promises preserve drafts
Loader failures preserve drafts, retry accepts fresh props and stale loads cannot overwrite
Runtime readonly and forbidden transitions cancel open editors and remove rendered content
Reset restores last acknowledged values including authored rule structure
Chinese composition cannot submit a stale answer or interrupt its current input
Destroy aborts pending work, releases local file references, and closes owned dialogs
Dirty author dialogs preserve input on cancel and require explicit discard
Live deadlines lock answers without an automatic submission and restart after data replacement
Pending editor close requires a deliberate discard and invalidates late acknowledgements
Locked practice steps and completed learning resources reject edits
Replacing business data clears stale grade selections and class filters
Both business laboratories expose real event-mode acknowledgement and actual payload logs
Modal business operations expose an accessible manual acknowledgement inside the dialog
